# /mandao-story

<!-- mandao:generated by npm run diagrams from core/commands/story.md; do not edit below -->

Create or enrich a user story with enough business context: sufficiency rubric, sources, AC-n with critical flags.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../diagrams/command-story-dark.svg">
  <img alt="/mandao-story: steps, approval and what it writes" src="../diagrams/command-story-light.svg">
</picture>

## Arguments

- `ref`: Tracker id or URL, a one-line idea, --from <file> (Markdown or PDF), or --intake <proposal>#I-n

## Reads

- `.mandao/sources.yml`
- `docs/constitution/`

## Writes

- `specs/<ID>-<slug>/story.md`
- `docs/product/intake/<doc>-<date>.md`

## Steps

0. From a document
1. Find or create the story
2. Sufficiency rubric
3. Write story.md
3b. UI mock (only when offered)
4. Approve (you approve)

## Approval

Yes: it stops for your approval.

## Scripts (no tokens)

- `mandao run next`
- `mandao run spec-new`
- `mandao run trace`
- `mandao run event`
- `mandao run mock-offer`
- `mandao run intake-extract`
- `mandao run intake-check`
- `mandao run intake-story`
- `mandao run intake-open`

Paths are the defaults; `paths` in `.mandao/config.yml` can change them.
